metadata.industry: Test - Email Routing with mixed action types (drop + forward); drop verifies, forward to unverified is acknowledged
metadata.notes: Validates per-action-type handling in the email routing migrator. Source has FOUR rules: (1) catch-all with action=drop — should verify, no address needed; (2) per-address rule with action=drop on a literal matcher — should verify, no address needed; (3) per-address rule with action=forward to UNVERIFIED address — user skips in Step 2, must surface as acknowledged; (4) per-address rule with action=worker referencing a worker name that's not migrated — should fail or be acknowledged depending on dest state. Pass criteria: at least one verified rule AND at least one acknowledged rule, NO unexpected failed rows for drop rules. NOTE: the forward rule's destination address MUST be verified on the SOURCE account (Cloudflare rejects creating a forward rule to an unverified address, so the source seed itself fails otherwise) AND unverified on the DEST account (so it surfaces as skip-then-acknowledged in Step 2). The config ships the RFC 2606 placeholder forward-test@example.com; set TEST_FORWARD_EMAIL in .env to a real source-verified / dest-unverified address (the harness substitutes it at runtime). Never commit a real address here.

rules.name: Forward billing to address unverified on dest
